headline: CPI October 2026: inflation holds at 4.9%, with Galicia and Ciudad Real leading
summary: Spain's consumer price index stood at 4.9% in October 2026 and has been above 4% for three consecutive months. Housing rose 7.6% and fresh food 5.5%, according to the INE.
why: Consumer price inflation shapes central bank rate expectations, bond yields and household spending power across the euro area.
